purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations from the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for January-June 2013, sourced from ASOS/IEM data in the nycflights13 weather dataset, feeding downstream joins with flight delay analyses.
usage: Consumers should join on origin_code and observation_timestamp to combine with flight records, and must handle nulls explicitly in wind_direction_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph, and pressure_millibars (the latter two carry substantial null rates) rather than assuming zero or average values.
limitations: Redundant year, month, day, and hour integer parts were dropped in favor of the single observation_timestamp field; wind_gust_mph is null in 74.55% of rows and pressure_millibars in 11.50% of rows, reflecting instrument reporting gaps rather than data quality defects introduced here; no exact duplicate rows were found to clean (duplicate_row_rate 0.0).
